ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two circles, the center of the left circle is labeled M, and the center of the right circle is labeled N. In the left circle there is chord ST, on the chord there is a pink tick mark, and beside the smaller arc intercepted by the chord is labeled 2x°. In the right circle there is chord UV, on the chord there is also the same pink tick mark, and beside the smaller arc intercepted by the chord is labeled (5x−27)°. The problem gives ⊙M ≅ ⊙N. Reasoning: Because the two circles are congruent, and the tick marks in the figure indicate ST ≅ UV, the arcs intercepted by congruent chords in congruent circles are also congruent. Therefore the measures of the two arcs are equal: 2x = 5x − 27. Solving gives 27 = 3x, so x = 9.

From the text, the two circles are congruent, so their radii are equal.
